remarks: Enjoy elevated living in this bright 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo at 91 Strawberry Hill Avenue. This 725 sq ft residence offers an open layout flowing from living and dining areas to a private balcony with treetop and city views. The galley kitchen offers ample cabinetry and workspace, and the bedroom features substantial closet space. The full bath is clean and timeless. This well-maintained 1959 brick building includes a fitness center, on-site laundry, a welcoming lobby, and convenient resident and guest parking. Ideally located moments from downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, parks, and major commuter routes, a polished, low-maintenance lifestyle in a central location.
